observations: Every measured flying-fish specimen with mass and lifting area in the project has wing loading W/(A_pectoral + A_pelvic + A_body) between 37.025 and 46.375 N/m^2 (n = 4).
caveats: stuffed specimens of one species (Cypselurus hiraii); n is tiny
model M has pelvic fins folded (A2 = 0)
a record bound, not an impossibility
